title: Ba Na in a day
summary: Give Ba Na the day. The basic ticket includes the round-trip cable car, the Golden Bridge, the French Village, and Fantasy Park. The wine cellar, the light area, the toboggan, climbing, and the cinema are extra.

stops.name: Ba Na Hills
stops.note: A full day. Non-resident adult 1,000,000 VND. A visitor over 70, and a child from 1 m to under 1.4 m, 800,000 VND. Under 1 m free. A child over 1.4 m pays the adult price. A Da Nang resident adult pays 650,000 VND, and a resident senior or a resident child in that height band pays 550,000 VND. The city tourism list and the operator’s 2026 price page give the same basic prices.
